content.text: Imagine running a thriving digital commerce business in Venezuela, only to be shut out by PayPal and Stripe due to a US sanctions regime. This is the harsh reality for many [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-everything-you-2|COREMERCH guide to creators]] and entrepreneurs. With the right infrastructure, however, they can break free from these restrictions and focus on what matters most - creating and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-notion-templates-crypto-explained-digital-creators-stripe-3|Selling Notion]] valuable digital products to their audience. This is where Google Apps Script comes in, a powerful tool for automating digital commerce workflows without relying on Stripe or any other [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-what-nobody-tells|payment]] gateway.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that allows users to automate repetitive tasks and workflows within Google Sheets and other Google apps. In the context of digital commerce, it serves as a powerful backend engine for processing orders, sending receipts, and automating other crucial tasks. By using Google Apps Script, digital creators can free themselves from the limitations of traditional payment gateways and focus on building a sustainable business model. With a correctly configured sovereign stack, orders can be processed in under 30 seconds, giving creators a significant competitive edge in the market.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Google Apps Script-based digital commerce automation relies on several key components. First, the Cloudflare Pages hosting platform serves as the frontend for showcasing products, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic for processing orders and integrating with payment gateways like NOWPayments. Supabase or Google Sheets provide a robust storage solution for orders, ensuring that all data is secure and easily accessible. Meanwhile, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery, making it easy for creators to distribute their digital products to customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is specifically designed for digital creators who operate in countries or regions where traditional payment gateways like Stripe or PayPal are restricted or unavailable. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is an example of a pre-built solution that includes everything needed to get started, from Cloudflare Pages to Supabase and NOWPayments. With a focus on sovereignty and infrastructure freedom, this solution empowers creators to build a sustainable business model that is not beholden to any particular platform or payment gateway.

By automating digital commerce workflows with Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers, creators can break free from traditional payment gateway restrictions and focus on building a thriving digital commerce business.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the heart of this infrastructure solution is the Google Apps Script backend engine, which integrates with Cloudflare Workers to process orders and interact with payment gateways like NOWPayments. Supabase or Google Sheets provide a rock-solid storage solution, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handle file delivery. The result is a seamless and scalable digital commerce automation workflow that can be easily replicated and customized to meet the needs of individual creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying a Google Apps Script-based digital commerce automation solution, follow these concrete steps: First, set up a Cloudflare Pages hosting platform for your frontend; next, integrate Cloudflare Workers with NOWPayments and Google Apps Script to process orders; then, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, customize and test your solution to ensure seamless integration and maximum scalability.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The webhook secret is the security mechanism that prevents fake webhook injection. NOWPayments signs every webhook with an HMAC hash using the secret key you configured in your account. Your backend recomputes the hash using the same secret key and the raw webhook body. If the hashes match, the webhook is legitimate. If they do not match, the request is rejected before any order processing occurs. This validation happens in under one millisecond. Combined with the independent on-chain transaction verification that follows, it creates a two-layer security model that makes fraudulent order injection effectively impossible against a correctly configured sovereign stack.
